description: Simon Vintage is a family-run vintage furniture and home décor store specializing in pieces from the mid-century and art deco eras, with a carefully curated mix of antiques, painted and refreshed furniture, and unique decorative finds at fair prices across a range of budgets. The shop has a warm, welcoming atmosphere where knowledgeable and genuinely passionate owners create an experience that feels personal and unhurried, with thoughtful displays both inside and out that make browsing a pleasure. It's the kind of place that earns repeat visits — charming, approachable, and full of character, with delivery options and a willingness to work with customers that sets it apart from the typical antique store.
